nextGame.note: Sunday home game in the Superdome against Carolina. Noon our time. The Saints and Carolina both have three wins and five losses, so whoever wins this one is alone in first place in their division.

news.headline: Erik McCoy is out Sunday and Kamara is ready to go
news.summary: The Saints ruled center Erik McCoy out of Sunday's game on Friday because of his hurt biceps, so Cesar Ruiz will play center against Carolina. Alvin Kamara practiced fully Thursday and Friday and is good to go, and running back Travis Etienne is a maybe with a sore hamstring.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara was back at practice Thursday
news.summary: Kamara rested his back and sat out Wednesday, then practiced fully on Thursday. Center Erik McCoy, who hurt his biceps on Sunday, has not practiced at all this week, so Cesar Ruiz will play center against Carolina.

news.headline: Saints pick their team doctor for a military award
news.summary: The Saints named head team orthopedist Dr. Stephen Choate as their nominee for the NFL's Salute to Service Award. He spent four years in the Air Force, rose to the rank of major, and has been the team's doctor for nine seasons.

nextGame.note: Saturday evening road game in Lexington, Kentucky. A quarter past five our time. Florida has won five games and lost four and needs one more win to reach a bowl game. Kentucky has won seven games and lost two.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: ESPN reported Thursday that Florida is going back to Philo to start Saturday night at Kentucky. Tramell Jones started last week against Oklahoma and threw two interceptions in the 23-7 loss.

news.headline: Florida lands a big offensive lineman for 2027
news.summary: Moreno Fisher, a 6-foot-7, 305-pound tackle from Charlotte, North Carolina, said Thursday he is coming to Florida. He had promised to go to Virginia back in June, then changed his mind last month and visited Gainesville the weekend before he picked the Gators.

news.headline: Ty Jackson earns a starting job at Florida
news.summary: Jackson barely played on defense for a season and a half, then blocked a punt against South Carolina and started getting more snaps. He made his first start against Oklahoma, and Coach Jon Sumrall has pointed to him as a player who keeps fighting.

nextGame.note: Saturday night home game in Baton Rouge. Half past six our time. LSU has won six games and lost three. Texas has won seven and lost two.

news.headline: LSU gets back a lineman who was supposed to miss the year
news.summary: Gabriel Reliford tore a knee ligament in spring practice and was expected to be out all season. LSU took him off the injury report Thursday and he can play against Texas, and linebacker Whit Weeks is still listed as questionable.

news.headline: LSU's coach has kind words for Arch Manning
news.summary: Lane Kiffin tried to get Manning to come to Ole Miss when Manning was in high school, and lost him to Texas. Talking to reporters this week before Saturday's game, Kiffin called him a great kid and said he hopes he does well, other than on Saturday.

news.headline: Whit Weeks may be able to play Saturday
news.summary: LSU listed the linebacker as questionable for the Texas game on this week's conference injury report. He has not played since ankle surgery in September, and last week he was listed as doubtful and did not play against Alabama.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Houston. One o'clock our time. Tulane has won four games and lost five. Rice has won one game and lost eight. Tulane needs to win two of its last three games to reach a bowl game.

news.headline: Tulane's coach liked what he saw at Tuesday's practice
news.summary: Will Hall talked to reporters after a closed practice Tuesday and said the team had a great day and that his players want to prove themselves. He said the Tulsa loss falls on him, and that Rice, up next on Saturday, has two fast quarterbacks who like to run.

news.headline: Tulane's coach takes the blame for the 60-10 loss
news.summary: Will Hall said the loss to Tulsa starts with him and that Tulane did not do anything well. He also said punter William Hudlow hurt a finger in the game and that he hopes to have him back this week.

news.headline: Tulsa routs Tulane 60-10 at Homecoming
news.summary: Tulsa led 32-0 at halftime and Tulane never got going, losing by 50 points in front of the Homecoming crowd at Yulman Stadium. It is the worst conference loss Tulane has ever had, and the Green Wave are now four wins and five losses.

nextGame.label: Playoff second round, against the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody
nextGame.note: Brother Martin is the 8th seed and does not play this week, because it has a bye in the first round. Its next game is the second round against the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody, on Thursday November 19 or Friday November 20. The place and the time have not been announced yet. Bonnabel hosts Peabody on Friday night. Bonnabel is the team that beat Warren Easton 29-28 last Thursday.

news.headline: Brother Martin gets the 8th seed and a first-round bye
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Brother Martin does not have to play in the first round and will wait for the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody.

news.headline: Easton Royal scores four touchdowns in Brother Martin win
news.summary: Royal ran for 165 yards and three touchdowns and returned a kickoff 75 yards for another in the 27-14 win over Holy Cross. Brother Martin finished the regular season with seven wins and three losses.

news.headline: Brother Martin beats Chalmette 27-21
news.summary: Brother Martin won a district game Friday night in Chalmette. The Crusaders are 6-3 and finish the regular season on the road against Holy Cross next Friday.
